remarks: WALK TO BEACH * WATER VIEWS * ROOM FOR A POOL This coastal gem sits on one of the largest lots near Compo Beach and has been thoughtfully renovated by skilled artisans and craftsmen, combining beachside charm with modern comfort. Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, the property features equestrian fencing leading to an oil-and-stone driveway and a flat, partially fenced yard with a spacious deck. Inside, the home offers generous rooms with high ceilings, two fireplaces, and an additional versatile room that can function as a fourth bedroom, au pair suite, or in-law apartment. The oversized kitchen features new appliances and a walk-in pantry, while a second-floor laundry/playroom adds convenience and flexibility. The primary suite impresses with a vaulted ceiling and private balcony. Additional highlights include central heating and air conditioning, fine millwork with shiplap walls, custom built-ins, modern vertical wood accents, and a rotating bookcase entry to the playroom. Owner-owned solar panels, installed in 2013, significantly reduce utility costs. Completing this coastal retreat is an outdoor shower, perfect for rinsing off after a day at the beach. Generous parking and ample yard space make it ideal for friends and family to enjoy year-round gatherings with quick access to nearby Compo Beach. Homes of this size and quality in this area are rarely available-this one is a must-see!
